prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square character profile illustration of ONE original male Ranger of the North, waist-up, three-quarter view, centered on light cream paper.
STYLE REFERENCES: use the four most recent attached book illustrations as visual style references only. Study their warm reddish umber/brown line color, variable fine contour weight, small clusters of short curved hatching, layered crosshatching in recesses, and pale unmarked paper highlights. Aim for their actual medium-density illustrative drawing style. More developed than a simple outline cartoon; much less tonally rendered than a realistic graphite portrait.
SUBJECT: a vigilant weathered man of about forty with shoulder-length wavy hair, a short beard, modest travelling cloak with hood down, a practical layered tunic, leather cross-body strap and small star cloak clasp. Quiet, resolute expression; natural slightly stylized book-illustration facial proportions, no actor likeness. One hand lightly holds the cloak edge near his chest, naturally drawn.
DRAWING: warm burnt-umber pencil and fine brown pen appearance, subtly irregular contours. Clearly articulate eyes, nose, cheek planes and mouth with selective lines. Build moderate brown shadows using visibly separated fine hatch strokes under brow, along shaded side of nose, beneath jaw, under overlapping cloth, and in cloak interior. Hair has distinct wavy locks with alternating cream highlights and dark brown hatched pockets. Cloth has flowing descriptive folds with hatching following form. A few fine seam and leather details. Reserve the deepest dark brown for small recesses and overlaps. Keep broad lit areas of forehead, cheeks and cloak as bare pale cream paper. Drawing should have intermediate depth, textured linework and engaging character detail, without blanket shading.
BACKGROUND: mostly blank very light ivory paper with subtle paper texture, a tiny sparse halo of thin sketch hatching immediately behind shoulders fading away. Generous margin around head. Suitable for square profile image, 640 by 640 export.
Avoid smooth blended shading, photographic realism, pores, photorealistic eyes, gray graphite wash, thick marker contours, sparse coloring-book outlines, flat cartoon styling, solid brown fills, full-color painting, scenery, text, border, watermark.
references: Four user-supplied character illustration screenshots, used as style references.
